captions.instagram:
Helping a parent with taxes? There's a new deduction for people 65 and older.

✔️ An extra $6,000 per person who is 65 by the end of the tax year, or $12,000 for a married couple when both qualify.
✔️ It's on top of the existing extra standard deduction for seniors, and you don't have to itemize.
✔️ It phases out above $75,000 of income ($150,000 joint). Married couples must file jointly.
✔️ Applies for 2025 through 2028.

Save this for tax season and share it with whoever does your parents' taxes.
Source: IRS, Working Families Tax Cuts.
